{{Quote|The last time I went on one of these ransom missions, I spent three weeks in a dungeon.|Senator Kharrus|audio=KharrusDungeon-TGG.flac|<ref name="gungan" />}}
A '''mission to Florrum''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The mission was to give [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] to a group of [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], who captured [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] for ransom. After [[High Jedi General/Legends|High General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were ordered to make sure that Count Dooku was really captured by the pirates and to then make contact with the Chancellor. [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] wanted to triple his spice payment and the Jedi were taken prisoner by the pirates and were held captive in the same cell as Dooku. Prior to the Jedi's capture, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] dispatched [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] to Florrum with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]]. The group's objective was to deliver the ransom of spice to the pirates. Unbeknownst to them, the pirates had already captured Kenobi and Skywalker.

After the group arrived in Florrum, [[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]], a member of the pirate gang shot down their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|Nu-class attack shuttle]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] Kharrus and the pilots. Binks was then named leading commander of the group, though Commander Stone had doubts of Bink's leading the mission. [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] pirate, [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]], the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of Ohnaka tried to stop the group and take the ransom for himself. However, Binks and the clones managed to stop Falso and his men before proceeding to the pirate camp. In the camp, Kenobi, Skywalker and Dooku tried to escape from Ohnaka, though failed. Dooku is locked up back in his cell, while the Jedi were being [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by Ohnaka. Binks disabled the electricity to the pirate camp before entering it, which allows Dooku to escape his cell and steal a ship to leave Florrum. Kenobi and Skywalker escape from their torture device and kidnap Ohnaka by using a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Jar Jar then enters the base with two stolen tanks and he and the clones and the Jedi departure from Florrum in the [[Twilight/Legends|Twilight]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|They are devious and deceitful and most importantly, stupid.''"<br />"''It's a wonder you don't get along with them, Dooku. You have so much in common.|Dooku and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="dooku" />}}
[[File:Skywalker_Ohnaka_Kenobi.png|thumb|left|200px|Ohnaka gets chummy with Skywalker and Kenobi]]
After Count Dooku was captured by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]], Ohnaka contacted the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and offered to turn him over for one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]' worth of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was reluctant to believe Dooku had been captured by a group of simple pirates, despite being shown holographic proof. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] suggested sending a pair of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to Ohnaka's base in order to confirm the pirate's claim. Once assured Dooku was indeed captured, the Republic would pay the demanded ransom for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader.

[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were dispatched to verify the veracity of Ohnaka's claim. When they arrived on Florrum, and after meeting Hondo Ohnaka, the two Jedi were taken to Dooku's holding cell. There, Skywalker proceeded to taunt the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Dooku replied by warning them that the pirates were lacking intelligence and were not to be trusted.

Kenobi and Skywalker were then invited to a banquet with the pirate leader. During the feast, several attempts were made to incapacitate the Jedi by drugging their drinks and food. These all were foiled by the pair until Ohnaka's pet [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|monkey-lizard]], [[Pilf Mukmuk/Legends|Pilf Mukmuk]] succeeded in dispersing the drug into the ventilation system, rendering the Jedi unconscious.

==The Mission==
{{Quote|Kill him! Kill him! He's no representative! He's a plague!|Weequay pirate after dealing with Jar Jar|audio=HesAPlague-TheGunganGeneral.flac|<ref name="gungan" />}}
Unaware that the Jedi had been taken prisoner, Chancellor Palpatine sent the requested ransom with senator [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and representative [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Binks]], who were accompanied by a team of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. However, as they arrived on Florrum, a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|saucer craft]] pursued them, shooting them down. Kharrus and both [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilots]] were killed in the crash.

[[File:Shot_down.png|thumb|left|180px|The ''Nu''-class shuttle is shot down over [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].]]
Meanwhile, Dooku used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to levitate a knife into the key slot of their holding cell, overriding the locking mechanism. Their escape was short-lived however, as they were re-captured and chastised by Ohnaka. Kenobi then used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince their guard to open the door and go get something to drink. The trio escaped again and made their way, unimpeded, through the halls to the base exterior.

At [[Doshar fields/Legends|the crash site]], the surviving clone troopers informed Jar Jar that he was now in command of the mission following Kharrus's death. Jar Jar and the clones buried the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] senator before a group of pirates, led by [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]], showed up to steal the ransom and kill the crash survivors. Jar Jar and the clones took cover in a geyser while the pirates took the spice. The pirates fled with Jar Jar and his troops in pursuit riding native [[Skalder/Legends|skalders]]. The pirates were fired on from behind, destroying several of their speeders and losing the spice in the process.

Meanwhile, the three escapees reached the exterior of the building though they were now spotted after tripping an alarm. Skywalker attempted to poll vault the three over the wall but came up short, all while being shot. While struggling to hang on to the perimeter wall, Ohnaka came and stood over his prisoners, once again taking them into custody. Falso, having survived the skirmish with Binks and his troops, falsely reported that the Republic had sent an army to wipe out the pirates and take their prisoners by force. He convinced Ohnaka to send tanks out to destroy the Republic forces. Ohnaka then personally oversaw the [[Torture/Legends|torture]] of Skywalker and Kenobi. Dooku escaped once more, make his way to the hangar and stole a saucer craft, killing Falso and his partner in the process.

[[File:Binks_tank.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] inadvertently takes control of one of the [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|pirate tanks]].]]
Binks and the clones, having taken shelter behind an outcropping of rocks, spotted the tanks sent to destroy them. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-5869]], nicknamed "Stone," sent Binks to negotiate with them, knowing that the pirates would be distracted by the bumbling Gungan. As Binks climbed aboard one of the tanks, he slipped, causing the driver to lose control and send the tank crashing into another pushing them both into the power lines. This knocked out power to the base and inadvertently freed Anakin and Obi-Wan. The two Jedi quickly recovered their weapons and proceeded to capture Ohnaka. Using the Weequay as a shield and hostage, they made their way out of the base to the landing pad where the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] was docked. There, Jar Jar and his clones arrived in the remaining commandeered Weequay tank. The Jedi let Ohnaka go and told him that they did not want revenge for all he had done to them. Though they warned Ohnaka that while they were forgiving, Dooku would not be, and he now knew where the pirates lived. The group then departed, leaving Florrum behind.
